title: Determine Surface Area of Prisms
objective: I can find the surface area of rectangular and triangular prisms.
model: net or oblique drawing of a rectangular or triangular prism, faces added (two triangles plus three rectangles)

widgets.root: Prism views checked: oblique view draws the hidden back edges dashed and labels length, width, height on three distinct edges; the net view is a valid cross net (top above the front face, left/right/back in one row, bottom below) built from one set of Lp, Wp, Hp so shared edges match. widgets.where: Practice §4.3-4.4 and Challenge §1.1-1.2, §1.5-1.6 (triangular variants of gen:surfaceAreaPrism L2, L4) and Challenge 2.5
widgets.component: generated and hand-authored triangular-prism problems drawn as a flat triangle with its base, height and two equal sides
widgets.root: Triangular-prism items (about 31% of gen:surfaceAreaPrism L2 draws and 29% of L4, so Practice 4.3-4.4 and Challenge 1.1-1.6, plus the hand-authored Challenge 2.5) are drawn with viz shape 'tri', which is only the end triangle: no prism, no length, none of the three lateral rectangles and no net, although the answer is the two triangles plus three rectangles whose width is the prism's length. The triangle's aspect is also clamped to 0.8-3 (a 24 : 5 end is drawn 3 : 1, 2.3 times too tall; 17 of 86 L4 draws are more than 1.5 times off). Sides and heights are consistent (every isosceles end satisfies (b ÷ 2)² + h² = side²).
widgets.replacement: Add triangular prisms to the viz kind 'prism': {"t":"prism","tri":{"b":24,"h":5,"s":13},"len":8,"unit":"in","labels":true,"net":false}. Oblique view: the end triangle in front, depth edge up and right, hidden edges dashed, the triangle's perpendicular height dashed with a right-angle mark, the equal sides ticked, and the length labelled on the long edge. With "net":true draw the net that folds: three rectangles of widths s, b, s and height len in one row, the two triangles attached above and below the middle rectangle, each face labelled with its dimensions. Remove the 0.8-3 clamp for the triangle (scale to fit). Use it for gen:surfaceAreaPrism L2 and L4 triangular variants and for Challenge 2.5, 4.3, 4.4, 5.2 and 5.5, and add a test that the drawn end triangle's b : h equals the given b : h within 2%.

widgets.component: Connect check: 'What is the chest's surface area?', 'How many cans of stain are needed for one chest?', 'The carpenter builds a second identical chest. Now how many cans?' (now carried with the Connect scenario text and the Connect diagram)
widgets.root: The scenario is now shown, but the figure is the Connect bar chart (bars Top & Bottom 12, Front & Back 12, Left & Right 8 with show:true): the bars print the three doubled face-pair areas (12, 12, 8) whose sum is the answer to item 1 (the labels also use the letter x). A bar chart is also not a picture of the solid or figure the questions are about. The item is answered by reading the chart.
widgets.replacement: Do not carry a bar-chart diagram into the Mastery section (diagramToViz should return null for kind 'bar-chart', or set show:false until after the answer is checked). Attach instead the chest: {"t":"prism","l":3,"w":2,"h":2,"unit":"ft","labels":true}, and show the bars only in the explanation after the student answers.
